sql: select x.scenario_key, (select string_agg((c->>'id') || ': ' || left(c->>'note', 330), ' / ') from jsonb_array_elements(x.checks) c where c->>'ok' = 'false') as falhas from public.ai_sim_results x where x.run_id = (select id from public.ai_sim_runs order by created_at desc limit 1) and x.status <> 'passed' order by x.scenario_key
